title: Product formula for Hermite functions
statement: For every natural number $n$, multi-index $\alpha:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$, and point $x\in\mathbb R^n$, the multivariate Hermite function is the product of its one-variable normalized Hermite polynomials: $H_\alpha(x)=\prod_{i=1}^n h_{\alpha_i}(x_i)$.
